free_parameters.name: left_size
free_parameters.why: derived value: witness trigger gives left.size()==1; the target condition only reads the two bitvector sizes, so 1 reproduces the witness exactly

free_parameters.name: right_size
free_parameters.why: derived value: witness trigger gives right.size()==1; combined width is then left.size()+right.size()==2, matching the witness boundary

free_parameters.name: left_value
free_parameters.why: concrete bitvector value is absent from the witness; the branch decision reads only left.size(), never the value, so any in-range value gives the same decision

free_parameters.name: right_value
free_parameters.why: concrete bitvector value is absent from the witness; the branch decision reads only right.size(), never the value

free_parameters.name: entry_tensor_len
free_parameters.why: size of the trivial CPU input passed to the official entry search_one; the target decision is made later by align_bvs and cannot depend on it

free_parameters.name: entry_dtype
free_parameters.why: integer dtype keeps the trivial SymbolNet on the non-differentiable SamplingSearch path of search_one, avoiding gradient search on CPU; it is never used by align_bvs

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixes the random state for deterministic repeats; the witness tensors are built with explicit values, so the target decision is seed independent
